displayName: portal: an error on the live site

documentation.content:
The live site (Cloud Run `portal`) logged an ERROR. See the log lines: Logs Explorer, project arq-proj, query `resource.labels.service_name="portal" severity>=ERROR`.

Usual causes: a maintenance pass failing (no new files scanned, no update emails), the email provider refusing an email, or a bug in a request. At most one email an hour while errors go on.
